invariants.requirement: Resolve source_role and rights_status from a trusted source_id registry; caller-authored roles or rights are rejected.
Retain suspended securities in the point-in-time universe denominator with tradable=false.
Apply one global known_at cutoff across every cohort and reject temporal leakage.
Treat an absent or uncovered official holiday calendar as BLOCKED, never as an empty calendar.
Reject every observation whose observed_at is later than the request known_at.
